title: Toasted Sesame and White Miso Dressing
description: Roasted tahini and white miso make a smooth Japanese-inspired dressing for warm vegetables, poached fish or rice.

ingredients.name: smooth unsalted tahini
ingredients.note: Choose roasted sesame tahini, then stir before measuring.

steps.title: Loosen the miso
steps.text: In a bowl, whisk {miso}, {aminos}, {maple} and {vinegar} with a small splash of {water} until smooth.

steps.title: Make the sesame base
steps.text: Whisk {tahini} into the miso mixture. Gradually whisk in the remaining water. If the sesame paste tightens initially, continue whisking until it flows.

steps.title: Finish the dressing
steps.text: Stir in {sesame}. Measure and whisk in extra water a teaspoon at a time to reach 1 cup of spoonable dressing.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Chill covered for 15 minutes, stir, then spoon over tender asparagus, warm rice or poached fish.

notes: Yield: About 1 cup. One serving is 2 tablespoons. Make ahead: Whisk a day ahead for a mellower flavor. Chilling thickens the tahini, so stir it before measuring a serving. Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze untouched portions for up to 1 month. Rewhisk after thawing to disperse the sesame oil. Fridge reheat: Serve chilled. Stir until smooth just before portioning. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw covered in the refrigerator, then whisk or blend briefly and serve cold. Option A uses rice vinegar. For gentler Option B, replace it with the same amount of water and halve the miso for a milder flavor. The dressing is dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/8 of recipe): 54 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 3.0 g total carbohydrate, 4.4 g fat, 0.8 g fiber, 74 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal.

steps.title: Fit the blade
steps.text: Use short pulses in a mini food processor for the mixing step. Scrape down twice. For butter, start softened; for mayonnaise, pulse just until combined.
